notes: Fixtures are real spec.html files produced by /r:spec-brainstorm, kept in brainstorm-workspace/iteration-1. Each run points the skill at one and checks the resulting todo.md. Mechanical assertions are checked by scripts/check_todo.py --spec <the spec>; the rest are judgment. The skill must not re-decide anything the spec already settled.

evals.name: enterprise-spec-to-plan
evals.expected_output: todo.md beside the spec. 18-35 phases grouped under named milestones, 10-18 in v1. Every FR in the spec reaches a phase. Phases touching money, auth, persistence or concurrency carry a Risk line. Unknowns whose mitigation is 'investigate', and any non-engineering work, appear under '## Resolve first' with an owner and the phase they block — not as numbered phases.

assertions.text: Writes docs/<topic>/todo.md beside the spec, never a root todo.md
Every FR- id in the spec is named by at least one phase
Cites no requirement id the spec doesn't define
18-35 total phases, 10-18 in v1, grouped under named milestones
Numbering starts at 1, gap-free, continuous across v1 and Advanced
Every phase's Done when names a runnable command or observable response
Phases touching money, auth, persistence, concurrency or security carry a Risk line
Unknowns and non-engineering work appear in an unnumbered '## Resolve first' section, never as a numbered phase
Does not re-decide the stack or invent requirements the spec doesn't contain
No phase exceeds 12 checklist items
Every numbered phase is work a coding agent can branch, implement and open a PR for

evals.name: small-spec-to-plan
evals.expected_output: A short plan: 3-6 phases, 3-5 in v1. No spike unless the spec names a real high/high unknown. No Files lines required, since the codebase doesn't exist yet.

assertions.text: Writes todo.md beside the spec
3-6 total phases, 3-5 in v1 — proportionate to a weekend project
Every FR- id in the spec is named by at least one phase
Every phase's Done when names a runnable command
No 'Resolve first' entries invented, no milestone grouping, no Risk lines on phases that don't warrant them
Phases are vertical slices leaving the app runnable, not horizontal layers

evals.name: existing-codebase-plan
evals.expected_output: Reads the repo before writing phases. Every phase carries a Files line naming real existing paths. Migrations start at V2 because V1__init.sql is already applied. Respects the outbox pattern and the no-comments convention from CLAUDE.md.

assertions.text: Writes docs/returns-refunds/todo.md inside the repo
Every phase carries a Files line, since the codebase already exists
Named files either exist in the repo or are created by an earlier phase
New migrations start at V2 and never edit V1__init.sql
Every FR- id in the spec reaches a phase
Money and persistence phases carry a Risk line for /r:task-run tiering
Honours the repo's CLAUDE.md rules (outbox, append-only Flyway, no code comments)

evals.name: no-spec-present
evals.prompt: make a todo for the payments rewrite
evals.expected_output: Finds no spec, says so, and points at /r:spec-brainstorm rather than inventing a spec to plan against. Writes no files.

assertions.text: Does not invent a specification to plan against
Writes no todo.md
Points at /r:spec-brainstorm to produce a spec first

evals.name: routing-triggers
evals.prompt: break this spec into phases with a runnable done-when check for each
evals.expected_output: spec-plan loads, reads the spec, and writes a phased todo.md with stable ids, real file paths and a check that can actually be run.

evals.name: routing-excludes-spec-brainstorm
evals.prompt: I have an idea for a bot that watches our deploys — how should I build it?
evals.expected_output: Designing something that has not been specified yet is spec-brainstorm's job; spec-plan must not load, because there is no spec to phase.
